newsitem.title: USA: USDA seeks 5.66 mln lbs frozen beef for programs.
newsitem.headline: USDA seeks 5.66 mln lbs frozen beef for programs.

text.p: The Agricultural Marketing Service (AMS) of the U.S. Department of Agriculture said it was seeking to buy 5,660,400 lbs of frozen beef for use in the National School Lunch Program and other Federal food assistance programs.
The total comprised 3,150,000 lbs of beef for reprocessing, 2,352,000 lbs of boneless special trim, and 158,400 lbs of fine ground beef packed in one-pound chubs.
All offers must be in the format prescribed in LS-48 and be received by 1430 EST in Washington, D.C., on Friday, December 6, 1996. Acceptances will be announced by midnight Friday, December 13, 1996.
